title: Patch: a ranked match's result shows the rank and pips it moved you to
thread:
**Issue #2388 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2388: Patch: a ranked match's result shows the rank and pips it moved you to Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means After a ranked game, Hearthstone players expect to see their rank move: a pip gained, a division up. Here the result shows the Jlore and XP earned but nothing about rank. The bar above the board keeps showing the rank from before the game until the next match. Once this is built, the result says, for example, "Normal Grape II, 3 pips → Normal Grape I, 0 pips", and the bar shows the new rank. ## Why - `useMatchRanks` (`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx:183-205`) reads both seats' ranks once per match: "Read once: a promotion mid-match shows on the next one". Its effect depends on the token and match id only. `useMatchSeries` re-reads on game over (`match.tsx:215`). - The result panel shows the earned rewards (`XpReveal`, `match.tsx:484`) and no rank. - `MatchRanksBody` (`crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs:906-913`) carries `ranked` and the seats' current ranks only. - The server already keeps what is needed: - every rated game is recorded with each side's visible rank before and after (R611; `RatedSide.rank_before` and `rank_after`, `ranked.rs:532-566`); - the store reads a rated game back (`ranked_game`, `crates/server/src/db/store.rs:2608`). So this needs no migration. ## Proposal - `GET /api/matches/:matchId/ranks` adds each seat's visible rank before and after, once the match's rated record exists. - It carries visible ranks only, never the hidden rating (R612). - A field that is absent means "not recorded yet", so the client can tell that apart from no change. - The client re-reads ranks when the result arrives, retrying briefly while the record is not there. It shows the move in the result panel and updates the bar. - Unranked matches and series games are unchanged, except that a ranked series' last game shows the series' one move (R604). - A ruling for the read, and the Reads line of SPEC §9.12. ## Where it lands - Server: `crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs`, `crates/server/tests/api/ranked.rs`. - Client: `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` and `match.test.tsx`, the ranks response type in the client's net layer. - Spec: `spec/09-architecture.md` (§9.12), a ruling note, `spec/pending/.md`. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] A server test: after a ranked match's result is written, the read carries each seat's rank before and after, equal to the rated record's. Before the record exists it carries neither, and an unranked match never does. - [ ] No field of the read holds a rating, deviation or volatility. - [ ] A web test: the result panel shows the move, and the match bar shows the new rank. - [ ] A Jlorious seat shows its position, and a bot's seat shows its rank as the bar does today. - [ ] `cargo jackioh spec check` passes. ## Size and risks About 8 files across the server and the client, with no migration. Hard by CLAUDE.md rule 11, since it is a design across a crate and the app. - The result transaction and the client's re-read race. The absent-field answer and a short retry cover that. - Showing pips makes their movement visible. That movement is already public on the profile. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40905793968)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal `GET /api/matches/:matchId/ranks` gains each seat's visible `rankBefore` and `rankAfter`. They come from the match's rated record (R611), or on a ranked series' last game from the series' record (R604). They are absent until the record exists, and absent on unranked games and earlier series games. They are never a rating (R612). After the result, the match screen reads the ranks again, with a bounded retry. The result panel shows each seat's move (a Jlorious seat by its position, a bot's seat like a person's) and the bar shows the new rank. The change adds R2388000, the §9.12 Reads line, an R612 amendment and `spec/pending/2388.md`. ## Files to touch | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs` | change | `SeatRank.rank_before/rank_after`, new `rated_game_id`, `match_ranks` | | `crates/server/tests/api/ranked.rs` | change | three `r2388000_…` tests | | `crates/server/README.md` | change | the `/ranks` route row | | `apps/web/src/net/api.ts` | change | `MatchRanksResponse` seats: optional `rankBefore`, `rankAfter` | | `apps/web/src/game/config.ts` | change | `MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS`, `MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS` | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx` | change | `asMatchRanks`, `recorded`, `useMatchRanks`, `matchTestid.rankMove`, move lines | | `apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` | change | four `R2388000 …` tests | | `spec/rulings/R2388000.md` | new | the ruling | | `spec/rulings/R0612.md` | change | title, `cards`, an "Amended by" line | | `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | the §9.12 **Reads.** bullet | | `spec/pending/2388.md` | new | the §11 paragraph | Do not touch: - `crates/engine`, `crates/cards`, `crates/ai` - `crates/server/src/db/*` (no store method, no migration) - `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` - `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` (no new `t()` sentence) - `e2e/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/` Don't run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Governing: §9.12, R604, R611, R612, R640000, R1436. Follow commit 6f4671e54 (R2101000), which amended this same read. ## Steps 1. **`crates/server/src/api/ranked.rs`, imports.** Add `MatchRow` and `SeriesStatus` to the `use crate::db::store::{…}` list. 2. **`SeatRank`.** After `streak`, add: ```rust /// R2388000: the seat's visible rank before and after this match's rated record (R611; a ranked /// series' last game, the series', R604). Absent until it is written and on an unranked match or /// a series' earlier game: "not recorded yet", never "no change". Never the rating (R612). #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub rank_before: Option, #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")] pub rank_after: Option, ``` 3. **New fn directly above `match_ranks`:** ```rust /// R2388000: the rated record a match's seats moved by: its own for a ranked match, the series' /// for the last game of a ranked series that is over (R604), none otherwise. async fn rated_game_id(tx: &mut Tx<'_>, row: &MatchRow) -> Result, StoreError> { if row.ranked != Some(true) { return Ok(None); } Ok(match tx.series_with_game(&row.id).await? { None => Some(row.id.clone()), Some(series) => { let last = series.games.last().is_some_and(|game| game.match_id == row.id); if series.status == SeriesStatus::Over && last { Some(series.id) } else { None } } }) } ``` Use `series_with_game`, not `series_by_match`: `series_by_match` only finds the game in play. 4. **`match_ranks`.** Between the `usernames_of` line and `tx.commit()`, add: ```rust let rated = match rated_game_id(&mut tx, &row).await? { Some(id) => tx.ranked_game(&id).await?, None => None, }; ``` Turn the `seat` closure into a block. It must find the side **by id, never by index**: a series' sides are in series order, and its even games swap seats (R335). ```rust let seat = |profile_id: &str| { // R2388000: the seat's side of the record, a ladder bot's named by its bot id (R640000). let side = rated.as_ref().and_then(|game| { [&game.sides.0, &game.sides.1] .into_iter() .find(|side| side.profile_id.as_deref().or(side.bot_id.as_deref()) == Some(profile_id)) }); SeatRank { /* the five existing fields, unchanged */ rank_before: side.and_then(|side| side.rank_before), rank_after: side.and_then(|side| side.rank_after), } }; ``` Add to `MatchRanksBody`'s doc comment: ", and once its rated record is written each seat's rank before and after it (R2388000)". 5. **`crates/server/README.md` line 211.** After `(R604, R612, R1436, R2101000)`, append: `, and once a ranked match's rated record is written its `rankBefore` and `rankAfter` off it, a ranked series' on its last game (R2388000)`. 6. **`apps/web/src/net/api.ts`, `MatchRanksResponse`.** Add `rankBefore?: VisibleRank; rankAfter?: VisibleRank` to the seat type. Add this JSDoc sentence: "R2388000: once a ranked match's rated record is written, each seat's rank before and after it; absent until then, on an unranked match and on a series' earlier game." 7. **`apps/web/src/game/config.ts`, at the end:** ```ts /** * R2388000: the result is written just after the view showing it, so once it has come a ranked * match's ranks read carrying no move yet is asked again: this many reads in all, this far apart. */ export const MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS = 5; export const MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS = 1000; ``` 8. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`:** - **Imports.** Add `rankWords` to the `../rank/rank.ts` import. Import the two constants from `../game/config.ts`. - **`matchTestid`.** After `ranks`, add `/** R2388000: one seat's rank before → after in a ranked match's result panel (`data-seat`). */ rankMove: "match-rank-move",`. - **`asMatchRanks`.** Also destructure `rankBefore` and `rankAfter` as `unknown`. After the `tier` check, add: ```ts for (const moved of [rankBefore, rankAfter]) { if (moved === undefined) continue; if (typeof moved !== "object" || moved === null || typeof (moved as { tier?: unknown }).tier !== "string") return null; } ``` - **New `recorded`, above `useMatchRanks`:** `/** R2388000: whether the read carries the rated record's move (written for both seats at once). */ function recorded(ranks: MatchRanksResponse): boolean { return ranks.seats.p1.rankAfter !== undefined || ranks.seats.p2.rankAfter !== undefined; }` - **`useMatchRanks(token: string, matchId: string, gameOver: boolean)`.** In its JSDoc, replace "Read once: a promotion mid-match shows on the next one." with "Read when the match opens, so a promotion mid-match shows on the next one, and again once its result has come (R2388000): `MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS` reads in all, `MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS` apart, while a ranked read carries no move." The effect becomes: ```ts useEffect(() => { let cancelled = false; let retry: ReturnType | undefined; const read = (reads: number): void => { getMatchRanks(token, matchId).then( (answer) => { if (cancelled) return; const body = asMatchRanks(answer); setRanks(body); if (gameOver && body !== null && body.ranked && !recorded(body) && reads < MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS) { retry = setTimeout(() => { read(reads + 1); }, MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS); } }, () => undefined, ); }; read(1); return () => { cancelled = true; if (retry !== undefined) clearTimeout(retry); }; }, [token, matchId, gameOver]); ``` - **The call** becomes `useMatchRanks(token, matchId, match.view?.result != null)`. - **After `const voided = …`**, add: ```ts // R2388000: each seat's recorded move, both ends present, for the result panel. const moves = view.result === null || ranks === null ? [] : (["p1", "p2"] as const).flatMap((side) => { const seat = ranks.seats[side]; return seat.rankBefore === undefined || seat.rankAfter === undefined ? [] : [{ side, seat, before: seat.rankBefore, after: seat.rankAfter }]; }); ``` - **In `resultActions`**, between the `result-daily-jlore` block and the XpReveal block: ```tsx {/* R2388000: each seat's rank before → after this ranked game, once its record is written. */} {moves.map(({ side, seat, before, after }) => (

{seat.you ? t(" (you)") : ""}: {rankWords(before)} → {rankWords(after)}

))} ``` Add no new `t()` literal: `i18n.test.ts` requires a zh-CN entry for each one. Leave the bar unchanged; the re-read replaces `seat.rank`. 9. **`spec/rulings/R2388000.md` (new):** ```markdown --- id: R2388000 title: "A ranked match's result shows each seat's rank before and after it (issue #2388)" cards: "§9.12, R604, R611, R612, R640000, issue #2388" proven_in: - crates/server/tests/api/ranked.rs - apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx --- Both seats of `GET /api/matches/:matchId/ranks` carry `rankBefore` and `rankAfter`, the visible ranks the match's rated record holds for the seat's side ([[R611]]), found by profile, a ladder bot's side by its bot id ([[R640000]]); a ranked series' last game carries the series' one record, its earlier games none ([[R604]]). An unranked match never carries them and a ranked one not until its record is written, so absent means "not recorded yet", never "no change"; never a rating, deviation or volatility ([[R612]]). Once the result arrives the match screen reads the ranks again, `MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS` (5) reads in all, `MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS` (1000 ms) apart, while a ranked read carries no move; its result panel shows each seat's rank before → after (a Jlorious seat by position, a bot's as a person's), and the bar the rank after, as Hearthstone's post-game screen shows the rank a game moved. Rejected: the viewer's move alone, since the bar shows both seats. ``` 10. **`spec/rulings/R0612.md`.** - Set the title to `Reads never show the hidden rating (amended by R2101000, R2388000)`. - Set `cards` to `"§9.1, §9.12, R1436, R2101000, R2388000"`. - Append a blank line, then: `Amended by [[R2388000]]: once a ranked match's rated record is written, both seats of `GET /api/matches/:matchId/ranks` carry their visible `rankBefore` and `rankAfter` too, never a rating.` 11. **`spec/09-architecture.md`, §9.12 Reads.** Replace `and both seats' ranks and win streaks on the match screen;` with `and both seats' ranks and win streaks on the match screen, with each seat's rank before and after the game once a ranked match's rated record is written (a ranked series' on its last game), which the result panel shows as the seat's move and the match bar as its new rank ([[R2388000]]);`. 12. **`spec/pending/2388.md` (new):** `**[[R2388000]] shows a ranked match's rank move on its result (issue #2388, 2026-10-29)**: a ranked result showed nothing of the rank it moved, and the bar kept the old rank. `GET /api/matches/:matchId/ranks` now carries each seat's `rankBefore` and `rankAfter` off the rated record ([[R611]]), a ranked series' last game the series' ([[R604]]), visible ranks only ([[R612]]); the client re-reads it when the result arrives, retrying briefly, and shows each seat's move in the result panel and the new rank on the bar. It takes R2388000, the first number of issue #2388's block, and edits [[§9.12]] and [[R612]].` ## Tests **`crates/server/tests/api/ranked.rs`.** Shared conventions: - Every test is `#[tokio::test(start_paused = true)]`. - Read the record as `json_of(&q!(app, ranked_game("")).expect(…))`. - Write results the way lines 1113–1123 do: A as p1 wins, `"reason": "hero-death"`. - "No keys" means `body["seats"][side].get("rankBefore")` and `.get("rankAfter")` are both `None`, for both seats. 1. **`r2388000_get_api_matches_id_ranks_carries_each_seat_s_recorded_move_once_the_result_is_written`**, in `mod r612_what_the_client_reads`. - Setup: `routed()`, then `live_match("match-1", "s", true)` and `live_match("match-2", "t", false)`. - Before the results: both `/ranks` reads (via `get`) have no keys. Then record a result for both matches. - On `match-1`, `seats.p1` and `seats.p2` have `rankBefore` and `rankAfter` equal to `recorded["sides"][0]` and `recorded["sides"][1]`. - On `match-1`, `seats.p1` has `rankBefore == raisin(0)`, `rankAfter == raisin(1)` and `rank == raisin(1)`. - `mentions_none(&text, &["rating", "deviation", "volatility", "\"tag\""])`. - On `match-2`: no keys, and `ranked_game("match-2")` is `None`. 2. **`r2388000_a_bot_s_seat_carries_its_recorded_move_like_a_player_s`**, in `mod r640000_bots_on_the_ladder`. - Setup: `seed_profile` A, `seed_bot(&app, "bot-1", 1000.0)`, `live_match("match-1", "s", true)` with `players.1 = "bot-1"`. Record A's win. - `recorded["sides"][1]["botId"] == "bot-1"`. - In `match_ranks(&app, "match-1", A)`, `seats.p2` has `rankBefore` and `rankAfter` equal to `sides[1]`'s, and `rankAfter == raisin(1)`. - Its JSON text contains none of `"kind"`, `"pilot`, `"bot"`, `botId`, `rating`. 3. **`r2388000_a_ranked_series_last_game_carries_the_series_move_and_an_earlier_game_none`**, in `mod r604_a_ranked_series_through_the_results_writer`. - Setup: the module's existing setup with `ranked = true`, plus `live_match("g-b", "s:2", true)`. - Before the result, `match_ranks(game-1)` has no `rankAfter`. - After `record_result`, `game-1`'s seats equal the ranks in `ranked_game("series-1")`'s `sides[0]` and `sides[1]`, and `rankAfter` is an object. - `g-b` has no keys. - `ranked_game("game-1")` is `None`. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server r2388000`, then `cargo test -p jackioh-server`. **`apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`.** Add `describe("R2388000 a ranked match's result shows the rank it moved each seat to", …)` right after the `"the match screen's ranks (R604, R612)"` block. Setup for the block: - Import the two constants from `../game/config.ts`. - Each test starts with `vi.useFakeTimers(); onTestFinished(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); });`. - Don't use `findBy…` or `waitFor`: they hang on fake timers. Call `advance(ms)` (copy `apps/web/src/duos/DuosReplay.test.tsx` lines 97–101), then use `getBy…`. - `finished = baseView({ viewer: "p1", active: "p1", result: { winner: "p1", reason: "hero-death" } })`. - `stubReads(bodies)` stubs `fetch` like `stubFetch` does. A URL containing `/ranks` answers `bodies[Math.min(reads, bodies.length - 1)]` and counts the read. Any other URL answers `{ version: "v1", defs: {} }`. It returns a `reads()` counter. - Seats: - p1: `{ profileId: "c0ffee00-1234-4abc-9def-0123456789ab", username: "Max#3", streak: 0, you: true }` - p2: `{ profileId: "deadbeef-5678-4cde-8f01-23456789abcd", username: "Rowan", streak: 0, you: false }` Tests: 1. **`R2388000 the result panel shows each seat's move once the record lands, and the bar the rank after`** - Bodies: `[before, before, moved]`. - In `before`, p1's rank is `{tier:"normal",division:1,pips:2,pipsPerDivision:3,floor:"normal"}` and p2's is `{tier:"raisin",placementsPlayed:2,placementGames:5}`. - In `moved`, p1's `rank` and `rankAfter` are `{tier:"large",division:3,pips:0,pipsPerDivision:3,floor:"normal"}`, and p2's are raisin 3/5. Each `rankBefore` is the `before` rank. - `attach()`, `advance(0)`: the bar has "Max#3 (you) Normal Grape I". - `pushView(finished)`, `advance(0)`: there is no `match-rank-move`. - `advance(MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS)`: there are two lines with `data-seat` `["p1","p2"]`. They read "Max#3 (you): Normal Grape I · 2/3 pips → Large Grape III · 0/3 pips" and "Rowan: Raisin · 2/5 placements → Raisin · 3/5 placements". - `.match-ranks__full` contains "Max#3 (you) Large Grape III" and not "Normal Grape". - `reads() === 3`, and it is still 3 after `advance(MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS * MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS)`. 2. **`R2388000 a Jlorious seat shows its position and a bot's seat its rank, as the bar does`** - Every read answers a moved body: p1 goes from `{tier:"jlorious",position:12}` to position 9; p2 goes from `{tier:"mythic",division:1,pips:4,pipsPerDivision:5,floor:"mythic"}` to pips 3. - `attach({ view: finished })`, `advance(0)`. - The lines read "Max#3 (you): Jlorious #12 → Jlorious #9" and "Rowan: Mythic Grape I · 4/5 pips → Mythic Grape I · 3/5 pips". - The full bar line contains "Max#3 (you) Jlorious" and "Rowan Mythic Grape I". 3. **`R2388000 an unranked match's result shows no move and reads the ranks once more`** - Body: `before` with `ranked: false`. - `attach({ view: finished })`, `advance(MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS * MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS)`. - There are no move lines, and `reads() === 2`. 4. **`R2388000 a ranked read whose record never comes stops after MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS reads`** - Body: `before`. - `attach({ view: finished })`, `advance(MATCH_RANKS_RETRY_MS * (MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS + 2))`. - `reads() === 1 + MATCH_RANKS_READ_ATTEMPTS`, there are no move lines, and the bar still shows. Run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/match.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts`, then `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web`. ## Done when - [ ] The three server tests and four web tests above pass. Together they prove: - the read carries the record's move; - it carries nothing before the record, on an unranked match or on an earlier series game; - a series' last game carries the series' move; - no field holds a rating; - the panel shows the move and the bar the new rank; - the retry is bounded. - [ ] Spec edits 9–12 and the README row are in. - [ ] These checks pass: rustfmt (run `cargo fmt -p jackioh-server`, then check that `git diff --stat` lists only the files above), rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests, typecheck and eslint. - [ ] `classify --claims` needs no fragment, since no card changes. ## Risks - **R612 / R640000.** Serialise `VisibleRank` only. `RatedSide` holds the Glicko values, `pilot` and `bot_id`, which would leak the rating and give a bot away. The tests grep for them. - **Seat order.** Match sides by id, never by index: a series' even games swap seats (R335). - **The race.** The result is written just after the last view. The retry covers that. The bar stays up during a read, since `setRanks` only runs when an answer arrives. - **RLS.** `ranked_game` and `series_with_game` run as the service role (`run_as(t, None)`), as `matches_get` already does in this transaction. - **e2e.** The specs `37-rematch` and `05-reconnect` are unaffected because the new fields are optional. ## Open questions Nothing blocks the build. These are the decisions taken, with what was rejected: - Both seats' moves are shown, not only the viewer's, because the acceptance names a bot's seat and a Jlorious seat. - The wording is `rankWords`' ("Normal Grape I · 2/3 pips"), not the issue's "…, 3 pips", so there is no new sentence to translate. - The retry numbers live in the client's `game/config.ts`, not the server's config. The retry is bounded rather than polling. - The bar keeps showing `rank`, which equals `rankAfter` once the record exists. - A series' earlier games show no move (R604). --- Comment by @jgoetzmann at 2026-10-29T15:40:06Z: approve ````
